Candy Halbred.description: A sweet and sticky halbred made from the finest candy, perfect for those who love a little sweetness in their battles.

Cookie Shield.description: A sturdy shield made from the finest cookie dough, just don't use it if your opponent is hungry!

Cozy Reindeer Onesie.description: A warm and cozy onesie, perfect for keeping you snug during the holiday season.

Diamond Snow Aura.description: A sparkling aura of diamond-like snowflakes that glisten and shimmer with every movement, bringing a touch of winter magic wherever you go.

Neon Noiz Jacket.description: Wearing it may cause nearby pixels to start vibing aggressively.

404 Chic Top.description: The server couldn't locate this shirt, but fashion always finds a way.

Neon Noiz Pants.description: Warning: May attract moths and questionable dance moves.

404 Chic Skirt.description: Stylish enough to crash the village rendering engine.

Admin Fools Tools.description: Absolutely useless in your hands. Devs insist it's 'for decoration'.

Neon Noiz Shoes.description: Powered by vibes and unstable pixels.

404 Chic Boots.description: Error 404: Walking animation not found. Somehow still fashionable.

Aether Specs.description: See beyond the veil… or at least look like you can.

Glitch Aura.description: Not a bug. Definitely a feature.

Wink Eyes.description: A little wink goes a long way.

Spa Hat.description: A relaxing spa hat fit for a salt soak.

Spa Robe.description: A cozy spa robe for the Salt Awakening.

Deep Sea Salt Cave Background.description: A salt-encrusted deep sea cave backdrop.

Clam Shell Hat.description: A polished clam shell perched atop your head.

Shrimp Onesie.description: Snug, salty, and a little bit pinchy.

Brasil Jersey.description: Aqui é o Brasil. O melhor time no mundo!

Green Slime Hair.description: Gel-infused hair that stays perfectly in place, mostly because it's literally made of green slime.

Blue Slime Shirt.description: Cold, squishy, and surprisingly fashionable. It oozes confidence—and actual blue slime.

Slime Splattered Shirt.description: Either you just survived a massive slime explosion, or you are making a very bold fashion statement.

Sad Slime Pants.description: They sag a little bit at the knees. They aren't poorly tailored; they are just having a rough day.

Red Jelly Pants.description: Wobbly trousers with a translucent strawberry tint. Do not sit too close to a campfire.

Ascension Staff.description: A staff crowned with a shard of pure ascension energy. It hums softly when the clouds part.

Ascension Wings.description: Radiant wings said to carry Bumpkins beyond the clouds. No promises about the landing.

Salt Bottle Onesie.description: Shake things up! A pinch of salt goes a long way, and this onesie carries plenty.

Swamp Armor.description: A chest plate woven from the swamp's toughest reeds. Smells faintly of bog water.

Swamp Lily Hat.description: A blooming lily plucked straight from the swamp. The frogs are still deciding if they want it back.

Swamp Pants.description: Mud-proof pants for wading through the murk. What's living in the pockets is your problem now.

Moon Hair.description: Hair kissed by moonlight, glowing softly with lunar energy. A favourite of night owls and stargazers.

Crystal Shoes.description: Footwear cut from a single crystal node and polished to a shine. They chime softly with every step.

Marble Pants.description: Trousers with the cool veined sheen of polished marble. Far comfier than they have any right to be.

Spooky Coat.description: A tattered coat with a fur collar that never quite stops shivering. Something followed it home.

Surfer Hair.description: Sun-bleached locks with the salt still in them. Permanently windswept, even indoors.

Yellow Slime Puppet.description: A hand puppet made entirely of yellow ooze. It mimics your movements, though it looks slightly sticky.

Blue Jelly Shoes.description: Every single step you take makes a squelching sound. Incredibly comfortable, heavily distracting.

Sad Slime Slippers.description: Comfortable footwear that looks like it's about to burst into tears. Keep them away from salt.

Sad Slime Hat.description: A melting hat that droops over your eyes. It perfectly matches your mood on a rainy Monday morning.

Slime Wall Background.description: Transform your backdrop into a living, pulsating wall of pure ooze. Great for insulation, terrible for smell.

Rainbow Wings.description: Beautiful, translucent wings that reflect every color of the spectrum. You feel lighter just looking at them.

Butterfly Aura.description: A whimsical swarm of colorful butterflies constantly fluttering around you wherever you go.
